content:
maya: Heads-up — automated publish of redwood/inference-runtime:release-2026-03-20 reported success but the manifest only contains amd64. Deploy-bot started canary in eu-west and then hit a provenance verification error. Putting rollout on hold.

deploy-bot: :warning: promotion aborted: provenance attestation verification failed for digest sha256:8f3a...; blocked from promoting to prod. See logs for registry eu-west-1.

cheng: Which registry region and can you paste the manifest inspect?

maya: Registry: `123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com`
Output from `docker manifest inspect`:
```
Name:   redwood/inference-runtime:release-2026-03-20
MediaType: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json
Manifests:
  sha256:8f3a...@sha256:8f3a...
    platform:
      architecture: amd64
      os: linux
```
(no arm64 entry)

ajay: We should pin the canary to the previous known-good digest until this is fixed. Priya, can you extend the change window and update release notes to reflect the hold?

priya: Yes — please hold for up to 2 hours while we triage. I'll mark the release notes: "hold: multi-arch manifest missing (arm64) — rollback/pin applied" and notify stakeholders. Which previous digest should we pin to?

maya: Pin to `redwood/inference-runtime:release-2026-03-13@sha256:1111aaaa2222bbbb3333` (current canary). I'll rebuild with multi-arch and repush. Command I'm going to run:
```
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
  -t 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/inference-runtime:release-2026-03-20 \
  --push .
```

cheng: Also double-check the attestation flow — earlier `cosign verify-attestation` showed a timestamp mismatch (clock skew) and cosign refused to verify on the attestation payload. Might be why deploy-bot failed verification even after push.

ops-bot: Temporary mitigation applied: canary traffic routed back to `redwood/inference-runtime:release-2026-03-13@sha256:1111aaaa2222bbbb3333` and health checks passing. No user-facing errors observed.

ajay: :thumbsup: After maya repushes, run `deploy-bot promote --verify` and monitor canary for 30m before broad rollout. Also run `gcrane manifest inspect` and `cosign verify-attestation` as sanity checks.

maya: Starting multi-arch build+push now, will post logs. ETA ~25m.

deploy-bot: Noted — holding promotion. Will re-run verification when new image digest is posted and attestation verified.

maya: Update — push finished, new digest sha256:9c4b... pushed and attestation verified with cosign. Starting a manual promote to canary now (deploy-bot will still gate final rollout).
